### Omenic Overhaul: The Ultimate Tactical Adventurer Experience
**Omenic Overhaul** is a high-performance, "Modern Vanilla+" modpack built on the **Fabric 1.20.1** loader. Designed for players who want a tactical, immersive experience without sacrificing speed, this pack transforms Minecraft into a visually stunning and mechanically deep adventure.

Whether you are navigating massive mountain ranges or building complex automated factories, **Omenic Overhaul** ensures your game runs at peak efficiency on modern hardware.
